decision.observation: Striking the radiant shell creature triggered a massive light explosion (visible in the sub-frames) and a burst of pale shell fragments flying outward. Hornet now stands on the mossy ledge with 4 of 5 masks (took damage), needle drawn, with a white glow at upper-left and drifting shell shards.
decision.hypothesis: The creature bursts with damaging light when struck, but the explosion scatters it into shell-shard pickups. The area may now be safe if the creature is destroyed; collecting the floating shards and checking the rubble to the right is next.
decision.memory: Radiant shell creature: striking it causes a damaging light explosion but yields shell shards. Cost: 1 mask per strike.
